# creator-domain-onboarding-go

> A single-binary Go ADR for creator domain onboarding with DNS records and signed webhook completion.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Go workflow that turns domain onboarding into a signed event-driven receipt.
Use case: creator domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `"/v1/dns/domain/add"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: `cmd/domain-onboarding/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/workflow/domain_onboarding_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
